description: Old COSTARTS without exhaustive subset-state recovery supervision.
Baseline improved subset-utility router with exhaustive subset states, utility, pairwise, mix loss, expert embeddings, current encoder, unified M+1 action.
Train only on states reachable under the oracle path.
Utility regression loss weight set to zero.
Pairwise reranking loss weight set to zero.
Mix loss disabled; final selection uses the reranker path.
Replace unified M+1 action head with separate query and stop heads.
Evaluate the full improved router with cost-aware stopping at lambda=0.2.
Disable trainable expert ID embeddings inside queried forecast encoding.
Use a single-convolution history encoder instead of the current two-layer dilated encoder.
Optional DAgger fine-tune is not implemented yet; row is retained for paper-ready bookkeeping.
